summary: RE-REVIEW after the rebase onto 65c07dda (#954 merged). The pin at 557839d2 is void and its record is deleted in this same commit. WHAT IT CLOSES, MEASURED BY ME BEFORE IT EXISTED: both safety branches of the 04:00 owner handling could be DELETED with the entire suite green — dropping the _flip_owner_evidence_fresh gate left 46 failed/3605 passed UNCHANGED, and dropping the flip_owner_open_positions gate left 46 failed/3605 passed UNCHANGED. Real guards, doing real work, with nothing verifying them. WHY IT MATTERED MORE AFTER #948: that change deliberately routes MORE symbols through those two branches. Before it, a silent symbol never reached them because the live-bar guard turned the whole block away; afterwards every silent symbol in the clock sweep arrives at exactly these gates, which are the only thing between the sweep and retiring an owner that still holds a position or whose evidence is stale. THE TWO CONTROLS FAIL ONE-TO-ONE, which is the property I wanted: removing the fresh-evidence gate fails ONLY test_time_roll_keeps_owner_unknown_when_position_evidence_is_stale, and removing the open-positions gate fails ONLY test_time_roll_waits_for_an_open_owned_position_to_close. Reinstating the #948 bug (sweep passing owner_boundary_is_current=False) fails all three roll tests, so these also backstop the fix that motivated them. AND THEY ASSERT THE SAFETY PROPERTY RATHER THAN A FIELD VALUE: identity_writes == [] proves the opportunity was NOT retired, plus the owner-write reason and the preserved opportunity_id. Controlled full unit pair vs the NEW base 65c07dda: base 46 failed / 3767 passed, head 46 failed / 3769 passed, ZERO new failure names and ZERO fixed, base worktree existence verified before trusting the comparison. Ancestor PASS. Reviewer differs from the author. ⚠ PROCESS NOTE: I wrote 're-pin in progress' in a heading and never issued the pin, which left this PR's gate red while it read as done.
